newsitem.title: UK: Airbus says awaits full approval for Condor order.
newsitem.headline: Airbus says awaits full approval for Condor order.

text.p: Airbus Industrie senior vice president John Leahy said on Tuesday that the European consortium has initialled an order with German holiday airline Condor Flugdienst for up to 24 of its A320 family of shorthaul aircraft.

He told a news conference at Farnborough airshow, following earlier reports of the sale, that Airbus still only had a memorandum of understanding with Condor and is waiting for board approval from the German airline.

In another clash with arch-rival Boeing Co, Leahy said Airbus would not normally have announced an order until it had a signed agreement. But he said Boeing announced yesterday at Farnborough its own initialled order with Condor for a similar number of 757-300 aircraft.
"Both Boeing and Airbus have memoranda of understandings with Condor," Leahy said.
An Airbus spokesman said its potential order for six A320s and six A321s, as well as options on 12 more aircraft, could be worth over $900 million, based on list prices.
